description: Zones inondables - hauteur d'eau en mètre - Etat projet PAPI BSA 2030 - T10 Q100 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Flood zones - water height in meters - as part of the modelling of the PAPI BSA project state by 2030 - upgraded state 2030 - Hydroclimatic scenario (Maritime M10 - River flow Q100). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood zones - water height in meters - Project status PAPI BSA 2030 - T10 Q100" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondation, Risque naturel, crue, changement climatique, modélisation, lutte contre les inondations. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
